title: BMD BLE camera payload profile
description: Validates payloads/models/<MODEL_KEY>_<FIRMWARE>.json files at load time (camera_profile.validate_profile). Every protocol value in a profile must originate from a sniffer capture on that exact camera/firmware — see CLAUDE.md design principle 6 and docs/payload_profiles.md.

ble_name.description: Real BLE advertisement name broadcast by the camera — not a placeholder.

status.description: Whole-profile status. VERIFIED only after testing every populated section on real hardware. Per-command verification lives in commands.<name>.provenance.status.

characteristic_incoming.description: Only present when overriding the default INCOMING_CONTROL UUID in constants.py.

capabilities.description: Explicit capability model (CLAUDE.md design principle 7), e.g. supports_raw / supports_photo / supports_playback. Populate only once confirmed on the camera.

commands.description: One block per sniffer-confirmed command family (recording, photo, playback, ...), keyed by command name.

fps_encodings.description: FPS label -> [fps_int, flags] pair, e.g. "23.98": [24, 2048]. Sniffer-sourced per model.

storage.description: Per-camera storage-monitoring characteristics and decode hints. Deliberately loose until the first storage sniffer capture lands; tighten this definition then.

data_type.description: Symbolic name matching protocol/types.py DataType (official spec coding: VOID/BOOL=0, INT8=1, INT16=2, INT32=3, INT64=4, STRING=5, FIXED16=128). BOOL is an alias of wire code 0 — the spec's 'void/boolean'.

reserved.description: Header byte 3 as captured. Defaults to 0x00 when absent, but real cameras deviate (POCKET_6K_G2 v7.9 recording uses 0x01) — always record the captured value.

operation.description: Command operation byte. Absent means ASSIGN (0x00), the only operation observed on controller-issued commands so far.

values.description: Named payload values, e.g. {"start": 2, "stop": 0}. Names are what code and the discovery tool address; integers are the sniffer-captured payload bytes.

echo_operation.description: Operation byte the camera uses when reporting this category/parameter on INCOMING_CONTROL (0x02 CAMERA_REPORT on every capture so far). Raw integer so an unknown future value still round-trips.

status.description: Per-command verification state: VERIFIED = confirmed on real hardware, CANDIDATE = discovered but awaiting a repeat confirmation, UNVERIFIED = copied/assumed (should not normally exist — sniff instead).
